authoritative_user_requirement.audience: Overseas vehicle importers, dealers, fleets and procurement buyers
authoritative_user_requirement.interpretation: One recommendation and one buying guide; each has twelve complete language versions. The three specified sites are topic/data starting points, with OEM/regulator verification where necessary under existing source rules; not every article must pad its references with all three sites.

findings.finding: Writing Skill already requires twelve full-body language versions, minimum 900 English words, full locale fields and semantic language QA.
Current legacy pipeline checks EN/ZH markers and minimum characters, records reports/checkpoints; it is not a full autonomous twelve-language content generator.
Cloud pilot explicitly enforces two English-only initial drafts and has no localization or locale review stage.

No autobridgetrade.top reference and no yoojia.com reference was found in the audited main tree. This does not prove ownership of another deployment, but no current target-site deployment or URL-index mapping was established.
findings.evidence: git grep across main exact SHA; README still identifies AutoBridge Export

findings.finding: PR #3 adds only one manual workflow with its sole job unconditionally disabled. It cannot produce either English drafts or a twelve-language batch.
Merging the bootstrap changes main while the current pilot checks main against a fixed older SHA; a reviewed baseline update strategy is required before any activation.
Repository has existing source tiers, claim-level source boundaries, immutable article versions, CURRENT pointers, dedup rules and localization gates that should be reused.
The previously proposed UK recall and AC depot topics are both guides and do not satisfy the newly confirmed one-recommendation plus one-buying-guide composition.

website_observations.method: Public page retrieval only; not a website-wide audit

source_sites.reason: Ordinary retrieval timed out; Firecrawl returned an internal tunnel error. No current Autohome parameter page was verified.

source_sites.note: Model/category pages and user-contributed content coexist; homepage discovery is not verification of a chosen trim.
Commercial-vehicle product, parameter, quotation and article routes are exposed; no exact truck trim was selected.

website_observations.note: The live site exposes vehicle and buyer-guide sections with /en/...html article URLs. Existing repository URL registries must be reconciled with the actual target site before new-page decisions; locale completeness and current vehicle/legal facts were not independently revalidated.

decision.reason: Align source acquisition, one-plus-one composition, target site, localization/review and baseline compatibility before installing a useful manual entry point. Do not merge an inert English-only bootstrap merely to show deployment progress.
decision.supersedes: UK topic proposal is retained as historical work but is not the active batch intake.

budget.coverage: All existing pilot work across articles, stages, revisions and reruns
budget.twelve_language_completion_within_cap: NOT_VERIFIED; do not promise or silently increase cap

recommended_minimum_flow: Read current rules, target site's existing vehicle/guide URLs and pending articles; select one distinct vehicle recommendation and one distinct buying guide.

Use specified sites' exact model/trim data pages; distinguish structured data from dealer quotes, AI Q&A and contributor commentary. Verify material specifications with OEM/approval sources when necessary.
Record market, model year, trim, powertrain and test cycle, plus per-claim allowed/blocked facts and actual source provenance. Domestic retail/dealer prices are not export quotations.
Write and independently review an English master for each article before multiplying content.
Localize the two reviewed masters into the remaining eleven languages; preserve facts, units, numeric tokens, URL identity and source scope; independently review each full locale.
Deliver twenty-four complete language packages with public SEO fields, sources and documented image rights; store immutable versions and draft PRs.
Publish to autobridgetrade.top only after separate authorized review and verified deployment mapping.

skill_impact_check.research_impact: YES — source entrypoints and target-site live dedup
skill_impact_check.writing_impact: YES — exact one-plus-one batch and AutoBridgeTrade delivery mapping; preserve twelve-language standard
